steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Balance: symmetrical (formal, stable), asymmetrical (dynamic, informal), radial (centred, expansive). Emphasis: creating a focal point through contrast, position or isolation. | Key Fact: Proportion: the size relationship between parts — can be realistic or deliberately distorted for effect. Unity: coherence through consistent style, colour or motif. | Key Fact: Variety: visual interest through contrast, difference and change — prevents monotony. Rhythm: regular, flowing or progressive repetition that creates movement. | Key Fact: Design principles work TOGETHER — a composition balances unity and variety, uses emphasis within proportion, creates rhythm through balance.
